We are pleased to advise you that further to your application dated 25/09/2025, we offer you a credit facility in accordance with the terms and conditions set out in this letter.

In this letter the following words shall have the following meanings:
“Borrower” means

PURPOSE OF FACILITY
The proposed facility will be used by the borrower for  BUSINESS.
TENOR, AMOUNT OF THE FACILITY AND REPAYMENT

The maximum amount that will be available for draw down under the proposed facility shall not exceed the aggregate sum of Kenya Shillings 300,000.00 ( Three Hundred Thousand Kenya Shillings). The facility will be repaid directly by the borrower in 12 Monthsequal installments comprising of both principal and interest of Kshs  49,000.00( Forty Nine Thousand Kenya Shillings)starting after 30 days from the date of disbursement for the next 12 Months.
MODE OF PAYMENT

Salene Credit Limited KCB account number 1278186832-Kasarani branch, Equity bank account number 1750280157654-Garden City branch or M- PESA Pay bill business no. 4037865, Your ID as the account Number Or NCBA Paybill No. 880100, A/C No. 699232.
Note That All payments must be to the Lender’s account and no money shall be considered paid to the Lender if paid directly to, or through, the Lender’s staff or agents.

INTEREST

All advances made under the proposed facility shall attract interest from the date of draw down (as well as after and before any demand or judgment or the liquidation of the Borrower) at a flat rate of 8.00%per Month or such other rate as may be determined by the Lender from time to time. The Lender reserves the right to amend interest charges without prior notice to the Borrower.

PENALTY INTEREST

If the Borrower fails to pay any sum payable under the proposed facility on its due date, the Borrower shall pay interest on such sums from the date of such failure to the date of actual payment (as well as after and before any demand, judgment or the liquidation of the Borrower) at the rate of Ten per cent (10%) per month on the Principal Due. Cheques will be accepted as mode of payment to Salene Credit Limited but in case of bounced cheque, it will attract a fine of Kshs.5, 000 above bank charges.

VALIDITY OF THE OFFER

In case disbursement of the facility offered is not made within 7 days from the date of execution of the letter of offer, the lender shall be at liberty to reassess the material circumstances of the client including but not limited to the legal and financial position of the customer.
Where the circumstances are deemed to have fundamentally and adversely changed, the lender may revoke the letter of offer or impose any other conditions in the letter of offer.
The Cost of Financing above shall be recovered over the period of the loan together with the installment till loan is cleared
Client is to pay upfront; motor vehicle valuation fee of KES 4,000, CRB fees of KES 500 and joint registration fee of KES 1,175.
The valuation over the motor Vehicle shall be done by the Lenders Appointed valuers and is to be paid by the Borrower directly to the Lender.
The Motor Vehicle to be fitted with a tracking Device from the lenders approved supplier.
All perils insurance policy over the chattels and business assets to be taken through Salene  Insurance agency and or an insurer of the borrower's choice from the list of Insurance
Security to be perfected before drawdown

In the event of willingly tampering /removal/destruction of the tracking device the lender serves the right to demand full outstanding balance. The lender also reserves the right to retrieve and hold the motor vehicle until the issue is resolved, either by way of paying the loan fully or reinstating the tracking device; whichever the lender feels fit based on circumstance.

The motor vehicle to be comprehensively insured and the Interest of the lender be noted by the Borrower’s Insurance Company, if not the Lender can provide a Comprehensive Insurance cover at the IRA prescribed rate Subject to the market value. The cover will be provided through the appointed intermediary being Salene Insurance Agency. Payment for the same is done through the agency.

The borrower agrees that the Financier shall debit the Borrower's account with the applicable insurance premiums to facilitate insurance cover (s) over the Security (ies) including but not limited to instances where the borrower has failed to keep the security (ies) sufficiently insured and/or where the insurance cover (s) or policy/ (ies) has lapsed and further agrees to fully recover such amount (s) to the Financier including any accrued interest theron. The underwriter to provide a written confirmation that the cover is inclusive of the excess protector.

Upon recovery and subsequent sale of motor vehicle the Lender will deduct from the sale proceedings the; loan balance and interest, accrued cost of recovery including auctioneer charges, investigation cost, storage fees and the balance (if any) be refunded to the client.
If the loan amount is not fully settled even after the recovery and subsequent sale of the motor vehicle the Lender shall be entitled to recover the same from the Borrower.
Future borrowing will be dependent on positive repayment History on the Lenders Loan accounts.
RESCHEDULING/RESTRUCTURING OF A LOAN

If the borrower desires to have his/her loan rescheduled for a shorter or longer period than the period stated in the agreement, the borrower can apply to the company in writing upon payment of Kshs. 5,000 or 5% of the loan outstanding whichever is greater, provided the period of extension does not exceed 12months in aggregate from the time the loan was taken.
The credit committee will on be receiving the application deliberate on the borrower’s request and either approve or reject the application and communicates its decision to the borrower in writing.

FEES AND EXPENSES

The Borrower shall pay to the Lender on demand on a full indemnity basis, all expenses (including legal fees of the Lender’s and the Borrower’s Advocates and out-of-pocket expenses together with any taxes if any thereon), auctioneer’s costs connected with the recovery of money’s owing under the facility as well as the contesting of any involvement in any legal proceedings of whatever nature by the lender for the protection of or in connection with any account(s) or assets of the Borrower and also in connection with the negotiation, preparation and execution of this letter and/or the security documents, the fulfillment of all conditions of the propose facility and/or otherwise in respect of any monies owing under or in respect of the proposed facility.
DISPUTE RESOLUTION

The Parties agree that should a dispute arise with respect to the provisions of this Agreement, they shall make good faith efforts to resolve the dispute on a business basis through negotiations between the Parties’ principals.  Such consultations shall begin immediately after any of the Parties have delivered to the others written request for such consultation.

If within fifteen (15) days following the date in which such notice is given the dispute cannot be resolved, the Parties agree to submit the matter to a single arbitrator to be appointed by the Parties jointly and failing agreement by the Chairman for the time being, of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, Kenyan Chapter. Such arbitration shall be conducted in Nairobi and resolved in accordance with the provisions of Arbitration Act of 1995 as amended from time to time. The decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding upon the Parties to the fullest extent permissible by law.

This offer letter, and all disputes and claims arising out of or in connection with it, shall be governed by the laws of Kenya and subject to the provisions of Arbitration Act of 1995 as amended from time to time
CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAUS
The Borrower expressly consents and allows the lender to forward personal data and full file credit information to licensed credit reference bureaus.
EARLY REPAYMENTS

The borrower can settle his/her loan early upon payment of 15% interest monthly for the duration of the loan advanced. I.e. if he/she took the loan for six months, he/she can settle the loan early by paying the principle plus 15% compounded interest fee for the period the loan has been in existence. However, if the borrower bounces any cheque or misses an installment, he/she is not entitled to any early settlement consideration.
In case of payoff by another financier, the borrower will be required to pay the lender an interest of 30% on the outstanding balance.

DEFAULT
The following events will constitute default and cause any amount outstanding under the proposed facility to become immediately due and repayable and any commitments hereunder cancelled:
The failure of the Borrower to observe or perform any other obligations under this letter and/or the security documents.

If any circumstances arise which in the opinion of the Lender have or may have a material adverse effect on the Borrower’s ability to perform its obligations under this letter and/or the security documents?

The Borrower admits in writing its inability to pay or shall become unable to pay its debts generally as they fall due, or become bankrupt or insolvent, or file any petition or action for relief under any bankruptcy, re-organization, and insolvency law.

The Borrower suspends or threatens to suspend its operations or, except in the ordinary course of business, sell, lease, transfer or otherwise dispose of all or any substantial part of the Borrower’s assets (whether by a single transaction or by a series) or all or any part of its assets are seized or appropriated by or on behalf of any governmental or other authority or are compulsorily acquired.

Any of the Borrower’s indebtedness is not paid on its due date or becomes due prior to its stated maturity or any guarantee given by the Borrower is not honored when due or called upon. The Borrower will indemnify the Lender against any loss (including loss of profit) or expense which may be incurred as a consequence of any default in payment by the Borrower of any sum hereunder when due and/or the occurrence of any event of default.
DECLARATION BY BORROWER
The borrower declares that: -
The information supplied by him/her in the loan application form is true and correct in all respects.
He/she has authorized Salene Credit Limited to issue the payment on his/her behalf to the holders of account/payee stated in the application form.
He understands that if his/her employment is terminated before the loan is fully repaid; the loan then outstanding will immediately become due and payable.

He/she is aware that having given the logbook of the motor vehicle used as security for the debt, together with the transfer of the said motor vehicle duly completed and executed in the favour of the Lender he/she acknowledges that: -
Until the loan is fully repaid, the lender is entitled to make recourse to its security, in the event of any default in payment of any installment.
The lender is entitled to have the said motor vehicle registration in its (the lender) name, before making such recourse.
In the event of such defaults the lender is entitled to repossess and dispose the said motor vehicle in such manner as it may in its sole discretion determine to be in its interest.
He is aware that concealment of the said motor vehicle or the cannibalization thereof, is a fraudulent act, actionable both as a criminal offence and by way of civil action.
He/she is also aware that failure to make arrangements for the payment of post-dated Cheques, upon presentation for payment, on due date is an offence, punishable under both civil and criminal law.
